### Implementation Verification

I verified the top 3 carry-forward priorities from 2026-09-02:

#### 1. API Key Sanitization (HIGH ~6h from 2026-09-02)
**Status**: ✅ IMPLEMENTED

Location: `src/mcp/config.ts:426-441`
```typescript
// Sanitize the API key at the write boundary. Users routinely paste
// keys carrying invisible clipboard artefacts (BOM, zero-width
// spaces, trailing newlines) that later cause 401s indistinguishable
// from a wrong key.
const cleaned = sanitizeApiKey(server.apiKey);
```

The `sanitizeApiKey` function (from `src/providers/auth.ts`) strips control chars (`\p{Cc}`), formatting chars (`\p{Cf}`), and surrounding whitespace, exactly as specified in Cline #13549.

#### 2. Abort Propagation to Subagents (HIGH ~6h from 2026-09-02)
**Status**: ✅ IMPLEMENTED

Location: `src/tool/tools/task.ts:627-648`
```typescript
let childSignal: AbortSignal | undefined;

if (sessionManager) {
  // If the parent was already aborted, refuse to spawn a child
  if (context.signal?.aborted) {
    costTracker.endTask(taskId!);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: 'Operation aborted',
      // ... cancelled status
    };
  }
  childSession = sessionManager.createSession(resolvedModelID, parentSessionId, {
    signal: context.signal,  // ← parent signal threaded to child
  });
```

Parent `AbortSignal` is threaded to delegated child sessions via `context.signal`, exactly as specified in Cline #13677.

#### 3. Environment Details Separation (MODERATE ~4h from 2026-09-02)
**Status**: ✅ IMPLEMENTED

Locations:
- `src/core/agenticChat.ts:436-468` — wraps memory/session context/repo map in `<environment_details>` fence with blank-line separation, duplicate-block prevention
- `src/providers/openai/prompt-cache.ts:100-111` — `hasEnvironmentDetailsBlock` trims leading whitespace before matching block tags

```typescript
// Alexi_change (kilocode 3fc9cb41f - fix(cli): separate environment
// details from user prompt text). Volatile blocks are wrapped in an
// explicit `<environment_details>` fence...
//
// Alexi_change (kilocode #13190 - duplicate-block prevention). If the
// assembled prompt already carries an `<environment_details>` block,
// skip the second injection...
const alreadyHasEnvBlock = parts.some((p) => p.trim().includes('<environment_details>'));
if (!alreadyHasEnvBlock) {
  parts.push(`<environment_details>\n${envParts.join('\n\n')}\n</environment_details>`);
}
return parts.join('\n\n');  // ← blank-line separation
```

Exactly matches Kilocode #13190 spec: blank-line prefix, duplicate prevention, trimmed tag detection.
